name: developer-guides-and-tools
description: Developer guides, cheat sheets, interactive references and practical utilities.

scripts.build: npm run build:addons && npm run build:handbook && npm run build:linux && npm run build:atlas && npm run build:sql && npm run build:catalog
scripts.check:generated: node scripts/build-catalog.cjs --check && node scripts/build-ai-addons.cjs --check && node scripts/build-ml-handbook.cjs --check && node apps/linux-command-reference/generate-static.cjs --check && python -B apps/ai-learning-atlas/build.py --check && node scripts/build-sql-course.cjs --check
scripts.check:browser: node scripts/check-browser.cjs && node apps/ai-learning-atlas/tools/browser_verify.cjs --stage final --gzip --output artifacts/edge-tests/atlas-browser.json && node apps/ai-learning-atlas/tools/browser_extra.cjs --output artifacts/edge-tests/atlas-extra.json && node apps/ai-learning-atlas/tools/contrast.cjs --out artifacts/edge-tests/atlas-contrast.json && npm run check:atlas:hosted
scripts.check:atlas:hosted: npm run build:atlas:hosted && node apps/ai-learning-atlas/tools/browser_verify.cjs --page .runtime/atlas-hosted/index.html --http-only --stage final --gzip --expanded-axe --output artifacts/edge-tests/hosted-browser.json && node apps/ai-learning-atlas/tools/browser_extra.cjs --page .runtime/atlas-hosted/index.html --http-only --output artifacts/edge-tests/hosted-extra.json && node apps/ai-learning-atlas/tools/hosted_verify.cjs
scripts.test: npm run check:generated && npm run check:linux && npm run check:atlas && node --test tests/*.test.cjs && python -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_external_links.py && node scripts/verify-migration.cjs && npm run check:links
scripts.site:build: bundle exec jekyll build && node scripts/build-atlas-hosted.cjs --site
